contaminated_whole_record.note: descriptive only: before 2019-09-10 the update_date is a migration stamp, so these waits are not waits

pre_decided_and_unapplied.note: Errata in status Reported whose target RFC has been obsoleted. The IESG's active statement says an erratum on an obsolete RFC should be Rejected on either branch of its own test. The rule is published; on these it has not been applied.

difficulty_proxy.note: Characters of orig_text + correct_text + notes. A proxy for how much there is to read, not for how hard the judgement is; reported so the routing claim is not left resting on an untested alternative.

verifier_identities.note: F-072's rule applied by a night that did not write it. Role suffixes only are folded; misspellings of a name are listed, not merged, because merging them would be this measurement asserting an identity rather than reporting one.
strings_with_a_parenthesis: Alexis Rossi (RFC Series Approval Board Chair)

equal_horizon_by_submission_year.note: Share of a submission year's errata that had a verdict within 365 days of being reported. Only years with at least 30 records already 365 days old are listed; the cohort restriction to 2019-09-10 makes 2019 partial.
